cause_quote: The migration removed `if (existing === content) { continue; }` and made the compiler call `await writeMemoryWikiCompiledCache(...)` on every compile, with the writer deleting the previous publication via `await store.deletePublication(config, parentPublicationId)`.
user_saw: An operator inspecting the Memory Wiki cache after recompiling an unchanged vault saw a new publication ID and a replacement cache row.
summary: Explicit Memory Wiki compiles now retain the persisted cache publication when the source identity and validated compiled output match.
reasoning: The migration diff shows that the previous file-backed compiler skipped writes when the existing cache contents matched. Moving the same cache to plugin state replaced that equality check with a fresh publication ID, a write, and deletion of the accepted predecessor even when the sources and output were unchanged. The fix's integration test checks publication ID, row metadata, and bytes across both warm and cold recompiles.
